turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Good afternoon, Orion Shield Insurance, Hannah speaking. How may I help you? Just so you know, this call is recorded for training and quality purposes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, a stone cracked my windscreen and I'm stressed about the cost. How much would I have to pay?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Understood, thanks for letting me know. Can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Ananya Iyer, 1 October 1983.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. And can you confirm your policy number or postcode?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's NM1 8LB.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you have a cracked windscreen and want to understand what you'd pay. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is it only the windscreen that's damaged?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, just the windscreen.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can't you waive the excess? It's only a tiny crack.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I completely understand why that's frustrating, but I'm not able to make an exception, it's a fixed term of the policy. I'm happy to explain how it works if that helps.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: So it'll definitely be covered?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can't promise the outcome, the claims team decides, but windscreen damage is something many policies cover.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. For windscreen-only claims the excess, which is the amount you pay towards a claim yourself, is $50. For other motor claims it's $250.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Right, I see.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Ms Iyer. I've noted your query under reference REQ-25923, and the claims team will contact you if you'd like to proceed.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've explained the excess that applies.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance, Ms Iyer. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
